title: Deployment Configuration for Elephant Elephant
summary: Complete CI/CD pipeline and deployment settings for production

files.content:
version: '3.8'
services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - MONGODB_URI=mongodb+srv://<user>:<password>@cluster0.mongodb.net/todo-elephant?retryWrites=true&w=majority
      - JWT_SECRET=${{ secrets.JWT_SECRET }}
    volumes:
      - .:/app
    restart: unless-stopped
  db:
    image: mongo:5
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME:admin
      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD=admin123
      MONGO_INITDB_DATABASE:todo-elephant
    volumes:
      - mongo-data:/data/db
volumes:
  mongo-data:
